title: A cover-dense affine presentation
statement:
Every object of $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ [sk-def-pe-site] has a pro-étale covering by pro-étale
affines over $X$ [sk-def-pe-morphisms]. For affine $X$ these form a full subsite whose
category of sheaves is equivalent to $\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proét}})$.

steps.text:
Cover $X$ by affine opens and cover their inverse images in $U$ by affine opens. On such a
chart the map is $R\to B$ weakly étale. [sk-thm-pe-indetale-refinement] supplies
$\operatorname{Spec}(B')\to\operatorname{Spec}(B)$ as a single faithfully flat cover, with
$\operatorname{Spec}(B')$ a limit of affine schemes étale over $\operatorname{Spec}(R)$,
hence over $X$. The site comparison lemma gives the equivalence of sheaf categories. This
is Bhatt–Scholze, Lemma 4.2.4. In detail: the affine ind-étale subsite is
[def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis], and the covering, finite-refinement and fibre-product
properties together with the equivalence of sheaf categories are
[lem-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis].
